name: How long does paint preparation typically take for an average-sized room?

mainEntity.name: How long does paint preparation typically take for an average-sized room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for paint preparation varies depending on the room's condition and size. For an average-sized room with minor imperfections, preparation can take anywhere from 4 to 8 hours. This includes cleaning, minor repairs, sanding, and masking. Rooms with significant damage, peeling paint, or extensive wallpaper removal could extend the preparation time considerably, potentially requiring a full day or more before any paint is applied.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation for an average room with minor issues typically takes 4-8 hours. Significant damage can extend this time.
